name: Read / write / edit files
description: Open, create, and modify workspace files with safety checks and approval prompts before changes.

name: Apply patch
description: Make precise, surgical edits to existing files when a targeted diff is safer than rewriting content.

name: Run commands & processes
description: Execute shell commands and longer-running processes to build, test, inspect, or automate work.

name: Web search
description: Look things up on the internet when a request needs fresh or verifiable information.

name: Web fetch
description: Pull readable content from a specific page or URL and treat it as evidence for the answer.

name: Web browser
description: Drive a real browser to interact with pages when simple fetching is not enough.

name: Create image
description: Generate images from text descriptions using the configured text-to-image provider and model.

name: Schedule (cron)
description: Create, update, pause, resume, list, delete, and run scheduled assistant jobs.

name: Load skills
description: Pull in reusable skill instructions, references, templates, schemas, or optional executable behavior.

name: Subagents
description: Spin up focused helper agents for independent parts of larger work.

name: MCP tools
description: Use tools exposed by connected Model Context Protocol servers.
